article_title: Laura Kuenssberg: I asked Earl Spencer who we should believe, him or the King?

tasks.prompt: How does Kuenssberg frame the disagreement between Earl Spencer and Buckingham Palace?
options: As a dispute over memories of Diana's death that cannot be resolved definitively, alongside a brother's grief
As a court ruling that establishes the King's account
As a disagreement only about Diana's burial location
As a newly discovered recording settling what was said
tasks.correct_answer: As a dispute over memories of Diana's death that cannot be resolved definitively, alongside a brother's grief
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה מחלוקת בין זיכרונות ועדויות לצד אבלו של אחיה של דיאנה, ללא הכרעה ודאית בעובדות שבמחלוקת.

tasks.prompt: What was unusual about Buckingham Palace's response to Earl Spencer's book?
options: It immediately published a complete transcript of the 1997 call
It issued a strongly worded statement despite a usual reluctance to comment
It endorsed his version of every conversation
It announced that the book would be withdrawn
tasks.correct_answer: It issued a strongly worded statement despite a usual reluctance to comment
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הארמון פרסם הודעה תקיפה בניגוד לקו הרגיל של הימנעות מהסברים ומתגובות.

tasks.prompt: What does “resolute” suggest about Earl Spencer during the interview?
options: He had changed his account repeatedly
He was uncertain whether he had met the King
He was firm in his conviction that his account should be heard
He refused to speak about his sister
tasks.correct_answer: He was firm in his conviction that his account should be heard
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה מתארת נחישות ועמידה איתנה על הגרסה שלו.

tasks.prompt: In the description of the Palace statement as “blistering”, what is the intended sense?
options: A quiet and approving message
A statement about unusually hot weather
A detailed medical description
A sharply critical and forceful response
tasks.correct_answer: A sharply critical and forceful response
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכוונה להודעה חריפה וביקורתית, לא לחום ממשי.

tasks.prompt: What distinction does Earl Spencer draw about the Palace's response to his claims?
options: It questioned his judgement rather than explicitly denying the allegations
It admitted his allegations had all been proved
It supplied a recording of the disputed conversation
It refused to mention grief at all
tasks.correct_answer: It questioned his judgement rather than explicitly denying the allegations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי ספנסר הארמון ערער על שיקול דעתו ועל זיכרונו, אך לא הכחיש במפורש את הטענות.

tasks.prompt: What does “riposte” mean in the account of a line in Earl Spencer's eulogy?
options: A private visit to Diana's island grave
A pointed response to the alleged suggestion that Diana would soon be forgotten
An eighteenth-century building at Althorp
A legal ruling against the Palace
tasks.correct_answer: A pointed response to the alleged suggestion that Diana would soon be forgotten
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מציין תשובה חדה; הוא טוען ששורת ההספד השיבה לדבר שיוחס לצ'רלס.

tasks.prompt: Identify two elements at Althorp that Kuenssberg describes as part of Earl Spencer's remembrance of Diana.
expected_points: Diana is buried on a wooded island in the estate's lake
A small green rowing boat is used to visit the island
The Temple bears Diana's name and quotations including a line from Spencer's eulogy
A huge stone urn marks the burial place
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים שמתוארים בביקור באלתורפ, בלי להסיק מכך ראיה לשיחה השנויה במחלוקת.

tasks.prompt: Why does Kuenssberg emphasise both the lack of an explicit denial and the impossibility of complete certainty about 1997?
expected_points: The Palace strongly challenges Spencer's presentation and suggests grief can affect memory
It has not explicitly denied the alleged words
Neither the interview nor the statement independently proves precisely what was said
The writer distinguishes confidence in a memory from external verification
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין טענות הצדדים לבין עובדות מאומתות; אין לטעון שהשתיקה מוכיחה את גרסת אחד מהם.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the competing accounts and Kuenssberg's approach to assessing them.
expected_points: Spencer alleges the then-Prince Charles reacted insensitively after Diana's death
The Palace issued an unusual strong statement invoking the effect of grief on memory
Kuenssberg questioned Spencer about his evidence and certainty
She notes there is no definitive way to know exactly what happened
The interview also portrays his continuing grief for Diana
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את המחלוקת, אופן הבדיקה והאבל, תוך ייחוס ברור של טענות ולא כעובדות מוכחות.

tasks.prompt: Analyse how the Althorp setting and Spencer's visible emotion affect the article without settling the dispute about the King's alleged words.
expected_points: The stately home and family imagery frame the long history between the families
The lake, island and Temple make Diana's memory tangible
Spencer becomes tearful and says he misses his sister every day
His sincerity or grief is not independent proof of a disputed 1997 conversation
The Palace's challenge to memory remains part of the account
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב ניתוח באנגלית שמבחין בין עוצמה רגשית לבין אימות היסטורי, עם פרטים קונקרטיים מהכתבה.
